Replies.Text:
Build log: Step 5.3, The local API, MCP and instructions. Built by Claude Fable 5.1 (Claude-CLI) on 2026-10-30. Nothing is committed.

What was built, by item:

1. electron/Proxy.js (new): Make( { Upstream, Token, About, Guide? } ) answers an Express router the page server mounts (electron/Page.js, its new Proxy option, in place of the 503 "through /servers/<key>" of before; /servers/<key>/api stays beside it). /api/* is forwarded to the window's upstream as it is, through Page.Forward (the piping /servers/<key> uses, now a function of its own taking a path and headers to add): a request with no Authorization gets "Bearer <the person's token>"; with no token yet (nobody signed in) the proxy answers 401 "sign in", as a Server would; a request carrying its own token is passed as it is; X-Consensus-Service and every other header pass through, the events stream too; no upstream answers 503 "no Server open in this window"; an upstream that does not answer 502. The upstream does the authorizing: the proxy refuses nothing of its own beyond those two sentences.
2. /instructions is composed locally: Instructions.Local( Base, Guide, { Edition, Upstream, Project, Others, SignedIn } ) (new in src/Instructions.js, beside Make, whose This server names an owner and a settings file the proxy has not): the local address and the Server behind it ("every call is forwarded to the Server <name> at <url>, which answers it as its own"), the window's project in the Client ("work in it alone, and give it where an operation takes a Project"; on a whole Server, the Server's projects by the person's roles), in the Desktop the current Server with the note that the other Servers are reached under /servers/<name>/api and that the current one changes as the person opens a project elsewhere, so an agent reads the instructions again when a call answers an unknown project; the token rule (a request with none acts for the signed-in person, this address adding their token; its own token passed as it is; until someone signs in, 401 "sign in"); the X-Consensus-Service header; the MCP address and the shim's line; then the common guide, .guides/build-with-consensus.md, which both installers now ship (build/client.json, build/desktop.json), no third guide.
3. /api/mcp is src/Mcp.js over a remote operations adapter: the definitions from Operations.Definition (no store behind them, so a project named rather than identified is passed on), Perform( name, participant, args ) turning the call into the upstream's REST request through Operations.Route (the method, the path with its parameters filled, a query for a GET, a JSON body otherwise) with the participant's token and service name, the answer's JSON as the tool's text and an upstream refusal a Refusal with its status, sentence and extra fields (an error result with the sentence and the extra); initialize, ping, notifications/initialized (202), tools/list and tools/call as on a server; a body that is not JSON the parse error, GET 405. The participant is the request's own token, else the person's, with its X-Consensus-Service; with neither 401 "sign in". The stdio shim reaches it unchanged with --server http://127.0.0.1:<page port> (bin/mcp.js's header says so).
4. The token to the app: electron/App.js Tokens() holds the latest token and its expiry (the exp claim of a JWT, in ms; null for another shape) and AttachHandlers takes Tokens, adding the "token" handler; the preloads of the Client and the Desktop give SetToken( Token ) (a send, no answer); session.js hands every token it gets to a bridge with SetToken, once per token: at the start, before every call (Token()), on a timer every 50 s while signed in (Clerk's tokens live about a minute and ClerkJS refreshes them), and null at a sign-out. The proxy reads the holder's Token() at each request.
5. The upstream: the Client's is the window's Server (none on the chooser); the Desktop's is the current root, which the page remembers as the shared key consensus.current-root (app.js, on root-changed, through ConsensusStored, so it lands in desktop.json's Remembered as the page's other keys do), the first Server until one opens. Both apps make the proxy at start (APP.ServePage( { ..., Proxy } ) passes it to Page.Serve) and print "the page and the local API on <url>".
6. The words: docs/guide/client.md gains "An agent beside the window" (the address, what it serves, the one line that starts an agent, the relay's line, the 401 and 503 cases); getting-started.md gains "An agent beside the Desktop" and a sentence under The Client; llm.md says every edition serves /instructions on its own address and the relay beside a window needs no token; api.md's MCP section and features.md's Client and Desktop bullets say the same; the guide pages are rebuilt (node bin/docs.js build, 14 pages, no problem); readme.md (the instructions paragraph and the layout sentence name electron/Proxy.js); .guides/build-with-consensus.md (This server beside a Client or Desktop window; the relay's --server there); .guides/run-the-smoke.md (a local API item under the Client); bin/smoke.js's Client part checks the local /instructions, the 401, a call with its own token and MCP tools/list (not run: it needs Electron with a screen and the owner's word).

Files: electron/Proxy.js (new), electron/Page.js, electron/App.js, src/Instructions.js, client/main.js, client/preload.js, desktop/main.js, desktop/preload.js, public/js/session.js, public/js/app.js, build/client.json, build/desktop.json, bin/mcp.js (header), bin/smoke.js, docs/guide/client.md, getting-started.md, llm.md, api.md, features.md and their .html, readme.md, .guides/build-with-consensus.md, .guides/run-the-smoke.md, test/Proxy.test.js (new), test/Desktop.test.js, test/Client.test.js.

How it was checked:

- test/Proxy.test.js (new), over a stand-in upstream that records every request, as test/Probe.test.js has one: no Server open is 503; nobody signed in is 401 "sign in" and nothing reaches the upstream; an agent's own token and its X-Consensus-Service pass as they are; the person's token goes on a request with none, the agent's own winning over it; a body and a query pass, the upstream's answers and its refusals pass as they are; the upstream changing (the Desktop's current root) sends the next call there, one that does not answer is 502; the roots' forwarding stays beside the proxy and adds no token; the page is still served. /instructions: the Client with no Server (503 said, 401 said, the MCP line, the common guide following), the Client on a project signed in (the Server named, the project line, the token rule), the Desktop (the current Server, the others under /servers/<name>), Local on its own for a whole Server. /api/mcp: 401 with no token, initialize, a notification 202, tools/list with the operations and no request to the Server, a tools/call read as the person with the service name and the JSON as text, a write with its body, the agent's own token winning, a refusal as an error result with the sentence and extra, an unknown tool -32602, a Server that does not answer and no Server as error results, not JSON -32700, GET 405. App.Tokens: the latest and its expiry from a JWT, none for another shape, null and an empty string forgetting it.
- test/Desktop.test.js and test/Client.test.js: each main requires Proxy.js, makes the proxy over its upstream and the token holder and passes Tokens to the handlers; the Desktop's current-root key; the Client's upstream and about; the bridges have SetToken; session.js hands tokens (hand_token, SetToken, the timer) and app.js remembers the current root; the installers hold the common guide (the Sidecar's not the Desktop's). The dead-export check: the only unread function is bin/docs.js Publish, as before.
- The whole suite: 332 tests, 330 pass, 2 skipped (the Clerk keys), 0 failed; the two known load flakes did not show.

Decided during the build: the composed text is a function beside Instructions.Make (Local) rather than a mode of Make, whose lines name an owner and settings the proxy has not; the Desktop's instructions name the current Server rather than its open project, since the main process knows the root the page is on (the remembered key) and not the project, and the Server's projects are one list_projects away; the token handler and holder are App.js's (Tokens, the "token" handler), shared by the two apps, the preload's SetToken a send with no answer; the proxy composes /instructions and the MCP in one router, mounted by Page.Serve in place of the 503s (the Sidecar and the Server, which pass no Proxy, keep them); the holder keeps the token's expiry as the plan says but the proxy sends the latest token whatever its age, since a stale one is the Server's to refuse with 401, which the agent sees, and the page refreshes it every 50 s while signed in.

Also, as the plan says: Step 5 (pln-m5d-sfr-lbu) is set Finished on this subplan's acceptance.
